spec: bonded.chebyshev, bonded.perturbed_quartic_bond_term, bonded.perturbed_angle_term, bonded.perturbed_improper_term, bonded.perturbed_dihedral_term, bonded.soft_perturbed_term
generator: lake exe spec-vectors (NewenSpec.PerturbedBonded.*Float; SplitMix64, fixed seed)
encoding: every float is the hex string of its IEEE 754 binary64 bits (f64::to_bits, Float.toBits); multiplicities are plain integers
layout_chebyshev: m, cos_phi; cos(m phi), d cos(m phi) / d cos_phi
layout_quartic: dist2, k_a, k_b, r0_a, r0_b, lambda, lambda_derivative; energy, f, de_dl
layout_angle: cost, k_a, k_b, cos0a, cos0b, lambda, lambda_derivative; energy, df, de_dl
layout_improper: zeta, k_a, k_b, q0_a, q0_b, lambda, lambda_derivative; energy, minus_k_dzeta, de_dl, zeta_wrapped
layout_dihedral: cos_phi, k_a, cospd_a, m_a, k_b, cospd_b, m_b, lambda, lambda_derivative; e_a, e_b, g_a, g_b, energy, de_dl
layout_soft: x, k_a, k_b, x0_a, x0_b, alpha, lambda, lambda_derivative; energy, k_eff_diff, de_dl
